title: Tuck Front Lever Hold
summary: A straight-arm hold with your body horizontal and knees tucked, working the lats and abs.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: pull-up bar or gymnastic rings.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.8 for lats (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.5 for abs (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.3 for upper back (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.25 for rear delts (minor): each working set adds 0.25 of a set to the weekly rear delts total.

setup.text: Pull your shoulders down and tuck your knees, lifting your hips until your back is level.

form_cues.cue: Press the bar down with straight arms
Arms stay straight. Pull down with the lats.

mistakes.text: Bending the arms to hold the position.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
